facts.text: Under the 4 to Finish Guarantee, Cal Lutheran covers the tuition cost of any extra time needed to finish a degree if graduation is delayed.

sources.title: 4 to Finish Guarantee - Undergraduate Admission | Cal Lutheran

facts.text: Cal Lutheran's Public Price Promise scholarship covers the difference in average cost of attendance between Cal Lutheran and University of California schools.

sources.title: Public Price Promise - Financial Aid - California Lutheran University
